description: Check a signed proof-of-spend receipt offline: schema, Ed25519 signature, mandate expiry, positive amount, quantity*unit_price == amount, refund not above payment. Use when an agent or provider returns a receipt and you need to know whether it actually proves the charge was allowed. Do NOT use to move funds or to confirm a transaction on-chain - nothing here reads a chain.

public_key.description: Ed25519 public key, base64url (from keygen) or 64 hex chars.

name: verify_receipt
title: Verify an agent payment receipt
